description:
For a plan (price, interval, trial) and a sign-up date: every legally required notice (the compliance plan's email tasks) with the recommended send date, the allowed window, the jurisdictions it satisfies and citations; plus kinds NOT required and why.
Use it to implement reminder emails / cron jobs correctly. Example: {"terms":{"price":99,"interval":"year","trial_days":30},"start_date":"2026-11-01"}.

as_of.description: Evaluate the law as of this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

cycles.description: How many renewals to plan (default one year).

jurisdictions.description: Where the business sells: "all" (default) or state codes like ["US-CA","US-NY"] ("CA" works too). Federal law is always included.

payment_methods.description: Payment methods offered (debit/ACH add notice duties).

plan.description: With site: plan name or price_…

price_change.description: A planned price change to schedule the notice for.

terms.description: The plan: price (or amount), interval, interval_count, trial_days (or site + plan).

cancel_timing.description: When a cancellation takes effect (default period_end).

cancel_url.description: https URL where subscribers cancel online (used in generated text).

interval.description: Billing interval: day, week, month or year.

intro_percent_off.description: Or the promo as % off (coupon percent_off).

trial_days.description: Free-trial days (0 or absent = no trial).

name: get_notice_schedule
title: Get the dates each required notice must be sent
